question: does a source-backed XLS open of a mini-stream-resident Workbook materialize the whole CFB root mini stream?
method: xls_source_attribution --mode owned-readat --operation open, 10 warmups and 40 samples, over every test-data/ole fixture whose Workbook stream lives in the CFB mini stream. CFB structural bytes are the exact geometry from change-0565 corpus-survey/survey.json: sector_size * (1 header + FAT + directory + MiniFAT sectors). payload_bytes is the remainder.
answer: no: payload bytes track the globals substream, not the root mini stream, on every fixture
